analyst.summary: Lloyds Metals is turning India's largest single iron-ore mine into an integrated pellet-DRI-steel-and-copper business, and FY26/Q1FY27 volume and profit growth has been genuinely exceptional. But the stock already trades at a rich ~27x earnings for what remains a cyclical commodity business, funded by a large multi-year debt-heavy capex program whose biggest payoff (the integrated steel plant) is still years away. We rate it a Hold: strong operating momentum, but the valuation leaves little room for the iron-ore price cycle or execution timeline to disappoint.
